newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, driven up by BTC.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, driven up by BTC.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 0.62 percent on Wednesday, largely boosted by strong demand for the shares of warehouse operator BTC, traders said.
Volume remained low, reflecting the continued absence of foreign investors.
"Our market depends on accessibility -- unless it opens up to foreign capital no major changes can be expected in the near future," said Andrej Ciuha, a trader at brokerage Inter Timex.
* The SBI index rose 8.38 points to 1,350.57.
* Turnover slipped to 92.8 million tolars from 93.2 million.
* BTC was the most actively traded and the top gainer, firming 1.8 percent to 14,559 tolars on volume of 1,556 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
